thread.title: Investment Thesis A comprehensive valuation of Apple (NASDAQ

author: Oleh Kombaiev
title: Investment Thesis A comprehensive valuation of Apple (NASDAQ
text:
Investment Thesis A comprehensive valuation of Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) after the publication of the last quarter results allows one to expect only the neutral dynamics of the company's value in the nearest quarter.

First, let’s take a quick look at the dynamics of total return.
Including the current February result, the total return of Apple’s shares has been showing a negative result and a downtrend over the last three months. The current month’s returns are within the bounds of natural volatility so far, but frankly, the situation does not inspire optimism.

Now, let’s look at Apple’s multiples.
Given the uniqueness of Apple’s business model and the stage of its life cycle, I consider it inappropriate to directly compare the multiples of Apple with those of other companies, simply because Apple doesn’t have direct competitors. In this case, in my opinion, the most optimal multiples are the P/E and P/S adjusted for the projected growth in profits and revenues, respectively.
